summary: i-80 Gold Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement detailing the issuance of 3,453,237 common shares at US$1.39 each to Vox Royalty Corp. as consideration for terminating the Amended and Restated Offtake Agreement dated August 23, 2023 (assigned to Vox Cayman on September 26, 2025). No underwriter or placement agent is involved, and the company receives no proceeds. The shares are issued directly to the seller. The offering price equals the NYSE American closing price on June 25, 2026. Watch for shareholder dilution and regulatory clearance on the TSX and NYSE American.
